title: Passenger Traffic and Progress of Reopening of Changi Airport's Air Routes
what_it_is: Passenger Traffic and Progress of Reopening of Changi Airport's Air Routes

sections.label: Changi Airport passenger recovery
sections.summary: As of early July 2022, Changi Airport's weekly passenger traffic had recovered to about 55% of 2019 levels and it was connected to 108 cities.

sentences.speaker: Mr S Iswaran
sentences.text: As of the first week of July 2022, weekly passenger traffic at Changi Airport had recovered to about 55% of 2019's average weekly levels.

sentences.speaker: Mr S Iswaran
sentences.text: Changi Airport is also connected to 108 cities by passenger flights as of July 2022, which is more than 65% of the number of cities it was connected to before the pandemic.

sections.label: Middle Eastern air hub recovery
sections.summary: International passenger traffic at Dubai, Doha and Istanbul had recovered to more than 90% of pre-COVID-19 levels even before June 2022.

sentences.speaker: Mr S Iswaran
sentences.text: International passenger traffic at the Middle Eastern air hubs of Dubai, Doha and Istanbul had recovered to more than 90% of their pre-COVID-19 levels even before June 2022.

sections.label: Changi Airport terminal reopening plans
sections.summary: As of June 2022 Changi led major Asia Pacific hubs in traffic and city links, and will reopen Terminal 4 and Terminal 2's southern wing to handle about 70 million passengers annually.

sentences.speaker: Mr S Iswaran
sentences.text: As of June 2022, compared to the major Asia Pacific air hubs, such as Incheon, Hong Kong and Bangkok, Changi Airport is ahead in terms of both international passenger traffic and city links vis-a-vis pre-COVID-19 levels.

sentences.speaker: Mr S Iswaran
sentences.text: To ensure that Changi Airport will be ready to manage the anticipated traveller flows, the Changi Airport Group has announced that it will reopen Terminal 4 from 13 September and commence departure operations in the southern wing of Terminal 2 from October.

sentences.speaker: Mr S Iswaran
sentences.text: This will enable the airport to handle up to pre-COVID-19 passenger traffic levels, or about 70 million passengers per annum, which represents about 80% of Changi Airport's pre-COVID-19 capacity.

sections.label: Preparing for 70 million passengers
sections.summary: Having met and exceeded an initial 50% target, the focus is now to prepare the aviation ecosystem and Changi Airport for a potential volume of about 70 million.

sentences.speaker: Mr S Iswaran
sentences.text: With that in mind, having set an initial 50% target which has been well and truly met and exceeded, our focus now is to prepare our aviation ecosystem and Changi Airport in particular, for a potential volume of about 70 million, which is at about the level that it was pre-COVID-19.

sections.label: Aviation workforce attrition
sections.summary: The aviation ecosystem has had an attrition of about one-third of its workforce over the course of COVID-19.

sentences.speaker: Mr S Iswaran
sentences.text: As I have shared with Members before, we have had an attrition of about one-third of the workforce in the aviation ecosystem over the course of COVID-19.
